recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多數為中大型芽細胞：染色質細緻、胞質灰藍，其中一個細胞的胞質周邊可見一圈小空泡（像珍珠項鍊），夾雜小淋巴球與一個分葉核嗜中性球；這種胞質邊緣微空泡是 BPDCN 常見線索。
features: Predominance of intermediate-to-large blasts with round to irregular nuclei and finely dispersed chromatin
Small cytoplasmic vacuoles, in one cell arranged along the cell periphery ('pearl necklace' pattern)
Scattered small mature lymphocytes and a segmented neutrophil
Occasional cells with irregular, tapering cytoplasmic outlines; smear stretch artifact (strand) across the field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows numerous intermediate-to-large blasts with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm. Several cells contain small cytoplasmic vacuoles, which in one cell are distributed along the inner cell membrane in a peripheral necklace-like pattern. Scattered small lymphocytes and a segmented neutrophil are present, and Auer rods are not seen. Findings are suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, which requires confirmation by flow cytometry or IHC (CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4, TCL1).

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei, more abundant cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and nonspecific esterase positivity, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular, MPO/NSE-negative and CD123-bright.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm with high N:C ratio and express TdT and B- or T-lineage markers rather than CD4/CD56/CD123.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are CD34+/CD117+ with CD13/CD33 and lack CD4/CD56/TCF4 co-expression.
